text:
ash: Quick idea — route-setting night at the office wall Friday? 6:30–8:30pm. low-key, bring pads if you have them.
mike: love it. can’t make 6:30 but 7pm works.
emma: I can lead a beginner-friendly 45m block if we get 3+ ppl new to bouldering.
ravi: count me in for route tape and music 🎶
maya: snack question — protein bars, bananas, or both? :banana: :muscle:
ash: both. also chalk budget? we’re low. can someone grab a block?
zack: happy to grab chalk and some tape. can I swing by the office 5:45 to set up?
emma: also can we do a little route-naming contest? winner gets a granola bar and bragging rights 😂
mike: yes to names. my vote: "Bug in the Boiler" for the crimpy traverse.
ravi: vote recorded. also begging for no crimpy names that make me feel old 🙏
ash: poll: what time should we start? react with emoji: :one: = 6:30, :two: = 7:00, :three: = 7:30
calendar-bot: Reminder created — Route-Set Night (Office Wall) — Fri 18:30 to 20:30. Link: https://calendar.redwood.work/event/route-set-2100012345
maya: hey FYI I've got two spare pads we can borrow for people who don't bring one.
zack: can someone bring a small first-aid kit? just in case.
emma: I’ll bring a lightweight kit and some tape.
mike: also quick beginner tip: feet first, hips close. trust your feet.
ravi: confirmed — I’ll bring a bluetooth speaker and a jump-rope for warm-ups.
ash: perfect. chalk: zack, snacks: maya, tape/first-aid: emma, music/warm-up: ravi. sign-up thread for routes? post your grade preference below 
emma: beginner/intermediate (V0–V3)
mike: intermediate/advance (V3–V6)
maya: beginner, V0–V2
zack: intermediate, can set V2–V4 boulders
ravi: olympic-ish warm-up smaller than my ego :P V1–V3
ash: sweet. see y’all Friday. bring water.
